name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible problem with the implemented balance tool

## Behavior

Describe what happened and what you expected. Include the Bun version and source revision.

## Reproduction

Provide minimal steps and synthetic data. Remove API keys, account balances, and identifying details. Report security issues through [the private channel](https://github.com/antongulin/speedyindex-mcp/security/advisories/new).

## Checks

List the checks you ran and relevant sanitized output.
